scope.summary: Implement StudioLayoutGrid (hsk.studio.layout_grid@1) as the alignment-guide overlay on a frame StudioLayer (distinct from StudioAutoLayout and StudioConstraint; a frame may carry all three): a uniform square grid with configurable cell size/color/opacity; column and row guides with a count and either fixed size (left/center/right or top/center/bottom anchoring plus offset) or stretch mode (margin + gutter), each guide set with its own color/opacity; multiple stacked overlays that render simultaneously and toggle individually; and saving a configuration as a named grid style in StudioStyleRegistry (MT-356) reapplied across frames/documents. The layout-grid panel is an operator surface.
expected_tests: argus: layout-grid panel reachable via author_id; uniform + column/row + stacked overlays
test: uniform grid cell/color/opacity; column/row fixed vs stretch; multiple stacked overlays toggle individually; save + reapply grid style
acceptance_criteria_original: StudioLayoutGrid uniform + column/row + stacked overlays + save-as-grid-style; author_id + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-047] `StudioLayoutGrid` (schema id `hsk.studio.layout_grid@1`) is the alignment-guide overlay on a frame `StudioLayer`. It is a rendering/alignment aid distinct from `StudioAutoLayout` (which repositions children) and `StudioConstraint` (which resizes children); a frame MAY carry all three independently.
[STU-DS-047a] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support a uniform square grid with configurable cell size, color, and opacity, for icon and pixel-alignment work.

[STU-DS-047b] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support column and row guides with a count and one of two sizing modes: fixed size with left/center/right (columns) or top/center/bottom (rows) anchoring plus offset, or stretch mode with margin and gutter. Each guide set carries its own color and opacity.
[STU-DS-047c] A single frame MUST support multiple stacked `StudioLayoutGrid` overlays (e.g. columns + rows + uniform) that render simultaneously and toggle individually.
[STU-DS-047d] A `StudioLayoutGrid` configuration MAY be saved as a named grid style in `StudioStyleRegistry` ([STU-DS-033]) and reapplied across frames and documents like any other shared style.

implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
